    if (max % 2 == 0) {
        return min * max;
    }
    return min * max - min * max % 2;
}

    long long min_val = min(n, m);

                    break;

                    break;

                    break;
                default:

            ans = (max_val == 3) ? 8 : usual(min_val, max_val);
            break;
        default:
            ans = usual(min_val, max_val);
            break;
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
